candidateOccurrences.sourceText: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: WEBは「heights of Dor」と記す。Naphoth-dorはその翻訳上の関連候補として扱い、独立した地名比定を断定しない。

wikipediaSearchNoteJa: WikipediaのDor記事を実読したがNaphoth-Dorまたはその地域名の記述は見つからず、同記事は古代都市Dorを扱う。対象は高さ/周辺地域名なので、都市Dorの記事を同一対象として結ばない。
rightsNoteJa: WEB public domain. Candidate index CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution retained; candidate coordinates not promoted.
